results.name: Cinerary urn on podium
results.description:
Cinerary urn on podium. Chamber tomb of the Pruni family near Chiusi, Etruria. 200-100 BCE. Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek (Copenhagen, Denmark). Made with Memento Beta (now ReMake) from AutoDesk.

Old man is reclining on a panther skin and purple cushions with gilt tassels. Gilt wreaths around his head and neck, signet rings and purple-edged cloak indicate his high rank. He is sacrificing wine from a gilt cup. 

for more updates,  please follow @GeoffreyMarchal on Twitter.

**CAT** Anell-segell que servia per marcar i autentificar en cera els documents escrits (habitualment, tauletes de cera). Datat del 150-50 aC, va ser trobat el 2017 al jaciment del Tossal de Baltarga (Bellver de Cerdanya) per un equip investigador de la UAB dirigit per Oriol Olesti. 

**ES** nillo-sello que servía para marcar y autentificar en cera los documentos escritos (habitualmente, tablillas de cera). Datado del 150-50 aC, fue encontrado en 2017 en el yacimiento del Tossal de Baltarga (Bellver de Cerdanya) por un equipo investigador de la UAB dirigido por Oriol Olesti.

**EN** Signet ring used to mark and authenticate writing documents (usually, tablets in wax). Dated to 150-50 BC, it was found in 2017 at the Tossal de Baltarga (Bellver de Cerdanya) site by a UAB research team led by Oriol Olesti.

results.name: Silver ring witn an inscription
results.description:
**Collection:** Prehistory and Historical Archeology Dept.

**Inv.-No.:** [UF-22958.41](https://www.online.landessammlungen-noe.at/objects/1117080)

**Material:** Silver, Carnelian

**Dimensions:** 34 x 28 mm

**Dating:** 1250-1400  CE

The oval setting has a flat base with four holes arranged in a diamond pattern. The low rear frame is fitted with a ring plate bearing the retrograde inscription ‘+ADONAY+AGLA’ between two pearl-bead border lines. The semi-opaque red carnelian is cut into a faceted shape. Two ring shank fragments have a flat triangular cross-section. Due to the arrangement of the inscriptions, it might have been used as a signet ring. However, the inscription with the popular protective charm AGLA (the Kabbalistic name of God A[tha] G[ibbor] L[e-olam] A[donai]: you are strong in eternity, Lord) ADONAY could point towards a magical protective purpose.

This object was digitized through the ‘Kulturerbe digital’ program of the Federal Ministry for Arts, Culture, Public Service and Sport.
